_about: Read by delegate.py and check_setup.py. Three harnesses: agy (Google Antigravity CLI), codex (OpenAI Codex CLI, ChatGPT plan) and claude (Claude Code headless, your Claude plan: the 'claude' mode). A worker is agy:<model>, codex:<model>[:<effort>] or claude:<model>[:<effort>].

codex_models._about: Known Codex models (the list your plan offers changes: see ~/.codex/models_cache.json). Any model id works in a chain; this list is for people.
codex_models.gpt-6-luna: fast and affordable, easier tasks: builder fallback, tester, scribe fallback
codex_models.gpt-6.1-sol: coding and everyday work: exploit-builder, reviewer fallback, writer, designer, scripter
codex_models.gpt-6-astra: complex coding: hardest pieces, security, balance
codex_models.gpt-6.2-sol / gpt-6.2-astra: newer, in the model cache 2026-11-17 but not in the user's picker: check before use

families._about: Model id prefix -> family. A tester or reviewer never runs on the family of the builder it checks (delegate.py --after). Claude mode has only one family, so there a checker must be a different model instead.

default_models._about: Used when a role file has no models: line. In full mode only agy/codex entries run; in claude mode only claude entries.

_executor: The executor base is the only one allowed to run commands (a short allowlist, exec_allow in PROJECT.md, or HexStrike over MCP). Every other base stays command-less. Keep its chain to trusted, non-refusing workers; a cyber project usually points the executor role at the lead or a trusted model.

claude_models._about: Claude mode (PROJECT.md mode: claude): workers run as headless Claude Code on your Claude plan; no agy or Codex needed. Aliases always mean the latest model.
claude_models.haiku: fast and cheap: parsing, scribe, findings
claude_models.sonnet: everyday work: builder, tester, executor, reviewer
claude_models.opus: the strongest thinker: researcher, security review, hard PoCs
